eng3_kind_info.extent_statement: minimum extent only; no capacity, upper bound or runtime index range is claimed; the declaration g_kind_info[1] is not a proven allocation size for a native runtime
eng3_kind_info.basis: mov edi,imm32 at 0x1c1b5 is a plain register move that always falls through to mov eax,[edi-4] at 0x1c1ba with edi = owner+4, so that load reads owner+0 exactly. Address 0x1c1ba is also a loop head (back edge jl 0x1c1ba at 0x1c275 after add edi,8); the proof uses only the fall-through edge from 0x1c1b5 and infers nothing from the back edge. The containing function 0x1c010..0x1c283 overlaps no recovery row, so the anchor is independent of every compared caller. Element 0 spans [0x3fbd0,0x3fbd8).
eng3_kind_info.use_form: Each reviewed use is a scalar mov r32,[idx*scale+disp32] (or equivalent unsegmented ModRM/SIB disp32) whose relocated disp32 equals owner+addend with 0 <= addend < 8 (loader-zero-indexed-v1).
